verdict.rationale: The evidence documents AgentOS, an MCP server, a CLI, and skills plugins that let external AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex act on an Airwallex account. That is connectivity for third-party agents, not a built-in AI assistant inside the Airwallex product, so it earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack shows an in-app assistant that users can delegate tasks to.
